ground_truth.source: ground-truth-A-web.md, 59 rows read from src/Web by hand, 56 at the reader's granularity (type arguments dropped); the last row is the Razor view, absent from the inventory (CG-R-78); plus 11 edges in the source-generated Mediator code of the Web project, read from the files a build with EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles wrote (Mediator.g.cs lines 70-74, 141-142, 592, 656-668), added after run 6's first pass listed them as walk extras

limits.incidence: A 45 directives in 71 files, B 342 in 1,610 (run 7, 2026-09-14); printed beside every headline
limits.what: Razor views are not in the inventory; every @inject in them is an unseen composition edge

limits.incidence: B 66 IHtmlLocalizer<T> edges left boundary behind AddViewLocalization on a variable; A 0 (run 7, 2026-09-14)
limits.what: a registration on a builder held in a variable is not recorded (only chains within one statement are)

limits.incidence: B 7 occurrences by source grep, A 0 (2026-09-14); unmeasured by the instrument
limits.what: parameter attributes are not emitted: [FromServices] method injection is invisible
GetServices<T> and GetService<T> are one resolution of T (service-locator collection injection)
middleware named by UseMiddleware<T> has no fact to root on

limits.incidence: reported per run as the table's opaque count (CG-R-94)
limits.what: a lifetime-named registration whose arguments are variables is parsed in shape, opaque in content

proxies.incidence: 0 of 293 marker-role edges on A+B run 5 (2026-09-14); the pre-v4 reading (declared members only) misclassified 293 of 293 and was repaired (P-1)
proxies.known_divergence: an empty interface used as a DI key or a type-test target is excluded although the container may register it
proxies.proxy: an interface with no method, property or event anywhere in its interface chain

proxies.incidence: unmeasured against a ground truth (2026-09-14); on B run 5 the provider ids were 39 of 346 factory-provider edges, the remaining 307 services (231) and collection injection (76) — the retired reading below
proxies.known_divergence: a solution's own factory interface (an IClockFactory) reads as a service and is resolved to its registered implementation, which is what composition chose
proxies.original_predicate: composition chooses the provider; the provider chooses later
proxies.proxy: Func<>, Lazy<>, IServiceProvider, IServiceScopeFactory, IServiceProviderFactory<> — the declared provider ids, nothing read from return types (P-5)

proxies.incidence: 48 of 48 generic-dispatch edges on A+B run 5 (2026-09-14) were generic services, none dispatch — no denominator effect, the label is informational
proxies.known_divergence: a generic service abstraction that is not dispatch (IRepository<T>) reads as dispatch; resolved by registration until a declaration supplies the edge (CG-R-61)
proxies.original_predicate: the type parameter is the act
proxies.proxy: an interface with generic arity above zero that is not a provider

proxies.incidence: 0 of 9 abstract-data edges on A+B run 5 (2026-09-14); 8 were framework-provided and are read as boundary/registration-not-read before the role since v4
proxies.known_divergence: an abstract class registered only through a wrapper the resolver does not read is excluded although it is a service
proxies.proxy: an abstract class no registration names as a service

proxies.incidence: 0 of 3 value edges on B run 5 (2026-09-14); A 0
proxies.known_divergence: a primitive the container does supply (an options-bound connection string) is excluded
proxies.proxy: a struct, enum, delegate, string or object

retired_proxies.incidence: 181 of 181 data-contract edges on B run 5 (2026-09-14): the divergence was the field
retired_proxies.known_divergence: a service whose API is property-shaped (IOptions<T>.Value, IHttpContextAccessor.HttpContext) was excluded although composition chooses it
retired_proxies.original_predicate: data-contract: a shape, not a dependency
retired_proxies.proxy: an interface whose chain declares properties only — retired, such an interface is a service (P-7)

retired_proxies.incidence: 231 of 346 factory-provider edges on B run 5 (2026-09-14) were services and 76 collection injection (now its own classification, P-6): the divergence was the field's majority
retired_proxies.known_divergence: a service that merely returns another service's result read as a factory
retired_proxies.original_predicate: factory-provider by return type: composition chooses the factory, the factory chooses later
retired_proxies.proxy: an interface with a method or property returning an abstraction — retired (P-5)
